headline: Catawba win at Lincoln Memorial and reclaim first place
dek: Wednesday's win at Lincoln Memorial put Catawba two points above Emory & Henry, with the same number of matches played. Neither side has lost all season, and both are out on Saturday: Catawba at home to Carson-Newman, Emory & Henry away to Wingate.
displaced_by: Catawba's win at Lincoln Memorial on 2026-10-21 put them back above Emory & Henry, so the standing headline is no longer true.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Mars Hill have scored 33 and conceded nineteen, yet have lost six times: a side that scores freely and still sits in the bottom half of the table.

wire.line: Neither Catawba nor Emory & Henry has lost all season, and both are in action on Saturday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest Emory & Henry's, the latest their home match with Palm Beach Atlantic in September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba's win at Lincoln Memorial on Wednesday was their eleventh of the season, against two draws and no defeats, with 35 scored and seven conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tusculum's defeat at Mars Hill on Wednesday was their ninth of the season, against two wins and two draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coker's home win over Mount Olive on Thursday was their sixth of the season, against five defeats and no draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry's home defeat to Montevallo on Tuesday was their tenth of the season, against two wins and two draws.

last_match.line: Coker have not drawn a match all season; Mount Olive have also lost to Mars Hill, Anderson and Wingate.

next_match.line: Carson-Newman have won every match since losing at Emory & Henry; Catawba have yet to lose at all.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
